name: obj-exporter
title: obj-exporter
description: Three.js OBJExporter utility for exporting 3D geometry to Wavefront OBJ format. Use when converting Three.js scenes, meshes, or geometries to OBJ files for use in other 3D software like Blender, Maya, or MeshLab.

related_skills.name: threejs
related_skills.reason: OBJExporter only outputs OBJ; threejs covers broader scene parsing/export workflows including per-link OBJ export plus baking, partitioning, and URDF articulation.
